name: Swonkie
description_en:
Swonkie is a product in the Social media management category. Its directory profile covers Social Media Monitoring, Posts Scheduling, Multi-User Collaboration, Customer Engagement, Brand Tracking, Auto Publishing, Analytics (Social Media), Content Management.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are Medium Business Small Business Freelancers. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $21.21. Offers Free-forever and Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: track selected social conversations and mentions; organize content through creation, revision and publication. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
